cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(slambench_rtabmap_driver CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "-O3 -march=x86-64")

find_package(RTABMap REQUIRED COMPONENTS core)
find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED)

add_executable(rtabmap_driver slambench_rtabmap_driver.cc)
target_link_libraries(rtabmap_driver rtabmap::core ${OpenCV_LIBS})
